content.metaDescription: For The Boys Mentor is a Stoic AI mentor concept for young men, focused on discipline, resilience and better decisions.

hero.eyebrow: Stoic AI mentor for young men
hero.headline: Build the man before the world tests him.
hero.lede: Calm, structured support for boys and young men to pause, reflect and make better choices under pressure.

phone.heading: What do you need today?
phone.checkInText: Start with a 60-second reset before the day tests you.

journeys.heading: Simple journeys, not an open-ended therapy bot.
journeys.text: The first version focuses on safe, guided paths for real moments: anger, overwhelm, rejection, discipline, decisions, daily reflection and journaling.

items.title: Anger Reset
items.text: Slow down before the reaction becomes the regret.

items.title: Anxiety & Overwhelm
items.text: Separate what is in your control from what is not.

items.title: Discipline Builder
items.text: Turn motivation into one clear next action.

anger.label: Anger reset
anger.heading: Pause before you react.
anger.mentorOne: You cannot control what was said. You can control what you do next.
anger.user: I want to message him back now.
anger.mentorTwo: Then we slow down first. What outcome do you actually want in one hour?
steps: Write it but do not send

overwhelm.label: Overwhelm reset
overwhelm.heading: Control the next step.
overwhelm.mentorOne: Name the pressure. Then separate what is yours from what is not yours.
overwhelm.mentorTwo: You do not need to fix the whole day. Choose one useful action for the next ten minutes.

rejection.label: Rejection reflection
rejection.heading: Do not let shame lead.
rejection.mentorOne: Embarrassment is uncomfortable. It is not an instruction.
rejection.user: I feel stupid about what happened.
rejection.mentorTwo: The stronger move is to learn from it without attacking yourself.

discipline.label: Discipline builder
discipline.heading: Return to the work.
discipline.mentorOne: Discipline is not a feeling. It is the next honest action.
discipline.mentorTwo: Start smaller. Ten focused minutes is better than another promise.

decision.label: Decision mentor
decision.heading: Think past the impulse.
decision.mentorOne: Before you choose, look at the consequence you are accepting.
decision.user: I need to decide what to do.
decision.mentorTwo: A strong decision respects your future self, not only your current mood.

schools.heading: Built around emotional fitness, character and practical action.

features.title: Daily check-ins
features.text: Short reflections that help users name what happened, what they can control and what comes next.

features.title: Guided journal
features.text: Private prompts around courage, discipline, patience, humility, confidence and self-control.

features.title: Decision mentor
features.text: Structured support before sending a message, arguing, quitting, fighting or taking a risky choice.

safety.heading: Not therapy. Not diagnosis. Not a replacement for trusted adults.
safety.text: The mentor should support everyday reflection and emotional regulation while clearly routing serious issues to urgent human help.

proof.heading: Black, charcoal, bold white type and the FTB yellow accent.
proof.text: The page uses the visual language from the supplied brand example and keeps the first version intentionally focused for a clickable pilot.
proof.imageAlt: For The Boys Mentor brand example shots

pilot.heading: Start with schools, youth organisations, sports clubs and workshop partners.
pilot.text: Validate with young men aged 13 to 18, test the five core journeys and collect feedback before building the full mentor app.

footer.tagline: Ancient wisdom for modern young men.
